title: Cheese and Olive Burekitas
subtitle: with ricotta and feta
description: Easy oil-and-vinegar dough half-moons filled with ricotta, feta and chopped green olives. You can also shape them as hearts or butterflies.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line 2 trays with baking paper.
Make the filling: crush the cheeses by hand, add the chopped olives and mix until even.
Bring the oil, water and salt to just under the boil in a pot. Remove from the heat, add the vinegar and stir.
Mix the flour and baking powder in a separate bowl. Gradually add the flour to the pot and knead by hand into a soft dough. Cool for about 5 minutes until the dough is pleasantly warm to the touch.

Roll the dough on a lightly floured surface to 4 mm thick. Cut 9 cm rounds with a glass or cutter. Place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each, fold into half-moons and press the edges with a pinch or a fork. For hearts or butterflies, use cookie cutters, place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of one shape, cover with a second and press the edges with a fork.

Place the burekitas on the trays, brush with beaten egg mixed with a tablespoon of water and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
